candidates.alt: 哦：女孩掀起沙发垫发现玩具兔，张圆嘴露出恍然发现的神情
candidates.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. One square vocabulary illustration. Exact target oh, interj., 哦: a gentle exclamation of sudden recognition or discovery. Show a school-age girl who has just lifted one sofa cushion and discovered her small missing stuffed rabbit beneath it. Make her face the clear focus: gently raised eyebrows, eyes newly widening toward the rabbit, lips softly rounded in a small spontaneous 'oh' expression, one hand pausing just above her chest while the other holds the cushion up. Her expression is mild understanding and pleasant surprise, not fear, pain, shouting, crying or exaggerated shock. The rabbit must be partly nestled in the newly uncovered spot so the cause of her realization is obvious. Tight uncluttered waist-up vignette with just girl, sofa corner, cushion and rabbit. Warm off-white background, hand-painted gouache with delicate colored-pencil texture, muted blue and coral, soft natural light. Center the face and discovery with generous margins. No speech bubbles, no drawn letters or sounds, no text, numerals, symbols, labels, logos, watermark, borders or card UI.
candidates.selfReviewNotes: 发现玩具后的圆口表情和轻微惊讶清楚；图像不能区别哦、啊、惊讶或找到等具体词，感叹词唯一性较弱。画面较近，头顶和身体部分贴边。
